headline: Dewlop
title: Dewlop | Whirlpool Water Starter | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Dewlop is a stage one Water Aniimo that can swim, and it evolves into Dewple at level fifty seven. Whirlpool Dewdrop costs ten energy, has power twenty and a fifteen second cooldown. Current Jet costs ten energy and has power twenty five. Homeland work is Hauling level three and Water level three. It is a cheap and easy way to start Water. Would you start your water team with Dewlop? Comment below!
description: Dewlop guide: a stage 1 Water Aniimo that can swim and evolves into Dewple at Lv. 57. Whirlpool Dewdrop, Current Jet and level 3 Hauling and Water Homeland work. Checked on aniimo.gg and metabot.gg in November 2026.
joke: Dewlop is mostly water, so it never has to carry a bottle.
